claims.text: Total income is the exact sum of the income lines, to the cent.
Total spending is the exact sum of the spending lines, to the cent.
Left over is income minus spending, and a negative amount is shown plainly with a minus sign.
Each spending line shows a whole-number percent of income, and the percents add up to the percent of income that is spent.
Each line's share of spending is a whole number, and the shares add up to exactly 100.
With no income, the page shows totals and no percents, and never divides by zero.
Messy typing never gives a wrong number, NaN or a crash.
A bad entry gets a calm message in plain words that names the line.
